---
title: "Table 1: patient demographics"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(glue)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

project_dir <- "~/Documents/repos/explant-seq"
df <- read.csv(glue("{project_dir}/data/metadata/explant-seq_clinical_metadata_DEID_260810.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
head(df)

df <- df %>%
  filter(`SEEG laterality` != "") %>%
  mutate(
    race_display = if_else(str_detect(Race, ","), "Multiracial", Race),
    rf_head_trauma        = factor(str_detect(`Risk factors`, "head trauma")),
    rf_perinatal          = factor(str_detect(`Risk factors`, "complication of birth") |
                                       str_detect(`Risk factors`, "early term birth")),
    rf_neurodevelopmental = factor(str_detect(`Risk factors`, "developmental delay") |
                                       str_detect(`Risk factors`, "learning disability") |
                                       str_detect(`Risk factors`, "intellectual disability")),
    rf_encephalitis       = factor(str_detect(`Risk factors`, "encephalitis")),
    rf_family_history     = factor(str_detect(`Risk factors`, "family history")),
    rf_fetal_alcohol      = factor(str_detect(`Risk factors`, "fetal alcohol")),
    rf_hearing_impairment = factor(str_detect(`Risk factors`, "hearing impairment")),
    rf_any                = factor(!str_detect(`Risk factors`, "^none$")), 
    mts_diagnosis         = factor(str_detect(tolower(`MRI findings`), "mts") |
                                         str_detect(tolower(`Pathology findings`), "mts"))
  )

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    `SEEG laterality` = case_match(`SEEG laterality`, "R"  ~ "Right", "L"  ~ "Left", "Bl" ~ "Bilateral"),
    `SEEG laterality` = factor(`SEEG laterality`, levels = c("Left", "Right", "Bilateral")),
    Sex = case_match(Sex, "M" ~ "Male", "F" ~ "Female"),
    Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Male", "Female")),
    race_display = factor(race_display),
    Ethnicity = factor(Ethnicity)
  )
```

```{r}
library(table1)

# --- table1 labels ---
label(df$`Age at explant`)        <- "Age at explant (years)"
label(df$`Epilepsy duration`)     <- "Epilepsy duration (years)"
label(df$`N electrodes`)          <- "Electrodes implanted (n)"
label(df$Sex)                     <- "Sex"
label(df$race_display)            <- "Race"
label(df$Ethnicity)               <- "Ethnicity"
label(df$mts_diagnosis)           <- "MTS diagnosis (MRI or pathology)"
label(df$rf_head_trauma)          <- "Head trauma"
label(df$rf_perinatal)            <- "Perinatal complications"
label(df$rf_neurodevelopmental)   <- "Neurodevelopmental complications"
label(df$rf_encephalitis)         <- "Encephalitis"
label(df$rf_family_history)       <- "Family history of epilepsy"

my_continuous <- function(x, ...) {
  with(stats.apply.rounding(stats.default(x, ...), ...), 
       c("", "Median [IQR]" = sprintf("%s [%s, %s]", MEDIAN, Q1, Q3)))
}

footnote <- "EXP002 excluded from the table since this was an ex-vivo implant during resection"
table1(
  ~ `Age at explant` + `SEEG laterality` + `Epilepsy duration` + `N electrodes` +
    race_display + Ethnicity + mts_diagnosis +
    rf_head_trauma + rf_perinatal +
    rf_neurodevelopmental + rf_encephalitis + rf_family_history
  | Sex,
  data = df,
  render.continuous = my_continuous, footnote=footnote
)
```
